# Audio, Acoustics, and Musical Instruments Repository Index

> A curated MODAVIS PhD-project dataset of 403 repositories related to acoustics, audio, musical instruments, organology, synthesis, and adjacent fields.

Version: 1.0.0
Catalogue snapshot: 2026-08-22
Version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22099291
Creator: Dominik Ukolov — Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich-Schiller-University Jena
Licence: CC BY 4.0 for data and documentation; MIT for build code.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/README.md): Scope, formats, build, citation, and licence.
- [Knowledge bundle](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/knowledge/index.md): Progressive OKF 0.2 browser.
- [Canonical JSONL](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/data/repositories.jsonl): Authoritative curated records.
- [Data dictionary](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/docs/data-dictionary.md): Field semantics.
- [Classification guide](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/docs/classification-guide.md): Subject and scope rules.
- [Query guide](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/docs/querying.md): SQLite, full-text, jq, and Python examples.
- [Citation metadata](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Dataset citation.

## Machine-readable metadata

- [Frictionless Data Package](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/datapackage.json)
- [RO-Crate 1.3 metadata](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/ro-crate-metadata.json)
- [Repository JSON Schema](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/schema/repository.schema.json)
- [GitHub snapshot JSON Schema](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/schema/github-snapshot.schema.json)
- [Subject vocabulary](https://github.com/modavis-project/audio-acoustics-instruments-index/blob/main/data/vocabularies/categories.json)

Curated records and dated GitHub metadata are separate. Classification expresses scope, not quality or endorsement. Listed repositories retain their own licences.
